programme.sub-title: The Aware Show - Power of Healing
programme.desc: Join Lisa Garr as she speaks with millennial Author, Speaker, & Inspirational Entertainer Justin Michael Williams about the true power of healing. Justin discusses creating a future of inclusion and diversity while using music and meditation to spread his message of waking up the world! Info: justinmichaelwilliams.com.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show - Finding Harmony When Overwhelmed
programme.desc: Feeling overwhelmed? Host Lisa Garr talks with author and women’s empowerment expert Christine Arylo. Finding balance may be challenging, but we can always strive for harmony and flow. Arylo discusses setting boundaries and allowing ourselves space to breathe by finding ways in which we can receive support. Info: christinearylo.com.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show - Power of Intentions
programme.desc: Today Lisa Garr discusses the power of intentions with best-selling author and international speaker Lynne McTaggart. An expert in consciousness, and editor of the magazine “What Doctors Don’t Tell You,” Lynne suggests going for “small wins” which all add up to greater success and flourishing health. Info: lynnemctaggart.com.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E1
programme.desc: HOPE IS HERE features inspiring and uplifting, relevant and refreshing, personal stories told by cancer survivors, their families, and the loved ones of those who lost the fight against this “emperor of all maladies” and sparked a movement that gives added meaning to their lives. Their moving stories show how the light of hope is salvaged from depths of despair.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E2
programme.desc: Lung cancer diagnoses for young, non-smoking individuals are a growing trend. But that didn't intimidate the athletic and courageous lung cancer patient, 21-year-old Jill Costello. Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E3
programme.desc: Hank Baskett was given the grim diagnosis of stage 4 lung cancer almost ten years ago. At the time his thoughts were not of himself but of how he was going to tell his family. In episode 3 of Hope is Here we meet Hank and his family and learn how he was able to push forward towards health with a hopeful attitude and mission that his cancer journey would be, in his words, a joyful one.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E4
programme.desc: Gina Hollenbeck is positive about life. Every day she lives with an optimistic desire to overcome and thrive despite a stage 4 lung cancer diagnosis. As a young mother of two boys, she forges ahead towards a vibrant and meaningful journey with a mission to help find a cure for not only herself but for others who suffer from this deadly disease.

programme.title: OmStars- Yoga Is Series
programme.desc: Today's lesson is on Spirit and how to tune into that space beyond the physical.

programme.title: OmStars- Yoga Is Series
programme.sub-title: Yoga Is - Day 30 Freedom Simple Bridge / Urdhva Dhanurasana
programme.desc: Day 30 of our challenge is built around Bridge Pose, a simple backbend.

programme.title: OmStars- Yoga Is Series
programme.sub-title: Yoga Is - Day 31 Home Padmasana/Seated Pose
programme.desc: We’ll use the seated pose Padmasana to explore what it means to be happy, peaceful and spiritually at home in your own skin.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.sub-title: Good Morning Joy - Following The Light Inside
programme.desc: 3x GRAMMY winner, J. Ivy, shares his transformation from a shy kid to a spoken word powerhouse. J. Ivy performs. Plus, a story about a bus driver who made a first grader's day, street interviews from NYC, and Daaji discusses the soul's evolution.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.sub-title: Good Morning Joy - Power of Positivity
programme.desc: Social media personality Bruce W. Brackett details his triumph over addiction and trauma giving hope to all facing challenges. Plus, head to Rhode Island for a heartwarming tale where students make dreams come true for a security guard.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Mom Didn't Fight for Me
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: My Husband Doesn't Want Me as a Business Partner
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.sub-title: I Don't Trust I'll Find Someone to Create a Life With
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: Relationships and Your Spiritual Journey
programme.desc: Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.sub-title: Relationships: How to Have Miraculous Relationships
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: La Mejor Navidad
programme.desc: Desde su divorcio, la ambiciosa Gloria ha dedicado todo su tiempo y su atención a su trabajo en Miami. Incluso sus hijos han pasado a un segundo plano. Cuando las circunstancias la obligan a pasar una navidad en familia en el rancho de su exmarido Eduardo en un pequeño pueblo de Jalisco, descubre que la felicidad y el amor suelen esconderse en las cosas más simples.

programme.title: Un Papa Para Navidad
programme.desc: Rebeca es una estrella de las redes. Se ha dejado encandilar de tal manera por la fama y el reconocimiento que su familia ha pasado a segundo plano. Pero una navidad un desconocido se presenta en su puerta afirmando que es su padre. Y aquel encuentro ayudará a Rebeca a recuperar lo verdaderamente importante en la vida.

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Escandalos - El Color de la Ley
programme.sub-title: Escandalos - El Color de la Ley
programme.desc: Una vieja gloria del deporte, ahora convertido en actor, es acusado de un doble asesinato. Pero el color de la piel del implicado, la postura racista del fiscal del caso y la excesiva intervención de los medios, convierten el juicio en un conflicto racial mediático que conmociona al país.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: Una joven desaparece tras un accidente aéreo. Todos la dan por muerta, pero cuando se enteran que en un pueblo costero hay una misteriosa mujer que ha perdido la memoria y que es capaz de hacer milagros, la esperanza de un milagro los moviliza a todos a buscarla.

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad
programme.desc: LUCAS es un famoso cantante. Su tema navideño “Mi Amor en Navidad” ha sido un hit desde hace casi dos décadas. Pero ya no siente deseos de seguir interpretando esta canción. Un diciembre decide tomarse unas vacaciones para reflexionar sobre su carrera y sobre su futuro y regresa al pueblo donde creció. Allí se rencuentra con ELISA, su amor de juventud y conoce a JORGE, el hijo adolescente de ELISA, que sueña con llegar a ser músico. A través de ellos se conecta con sus raíces y sus recuerdos y consigue de nuevo esos motivos que una vez lo enamoraron de la música, de la navidad… ¡y de Elisa!

programme.title: Una Deliciosa Navidad
programme.desc: Máximo y Luciana son amantes de la cocina. Pero hasta allí llegan sus coincidencias. Él es un prestigioso chef apasionado por la comida molecular, y ella es una cocinera intuitiva empeñada en rescatar los sabores de su tierra. Cuando el destino los junta, en plena Navidad, en el restaurante que Máximo hereda de su padre y que Luciana regenta, la combinación es explosiva. Pero también deliciosa.

programme.title: Novios Por Navidad
programme.desc: VALERIA siempre soñó con una boda navideña. Y cuando se hizo planificadora de eventos, eso se convirtió en su sello. Cuando decidió casarse con BERNARDO planificó su boda para Diciembre. Pero no contaba con que TERE, su mejor amiga, terminaría robándole el novio y la idea. Tere le pide a Valeria que organicé su boda para navidad. Valeria acepta y decide presentarse a la boda del brazo del novio perfecto. Pero para ello necesita conseguir un novio con urgencia. Y no se le ocurre mejor idea que pedirle a CAMILO, el dueño de la finca colonial que han alquilado para la boda, que se haga pasar por su novio. Valeria y Camilo son polos opuestos, pero la magia de la navidad hace lo suyo y la mentira termina convirtiéndose en un inesperado romance.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.sub-title: Isabelle Carre, Basile Alaoui, Roxane Mbanga
programme.desc: She is an actress who touches the heart. A César, two Molières and almost seventy films in a career spanning thirty-five years, Isabelle Carré is releasing "Les Rêveurs", her first film as a director, and it's big news! An 11-year-old prodigy, Basile Alaoui publishes his drawings on social networks and has already been noticed by the experts at "La Grande Galerie Francophone". When do you become an artist? How do you spot precocious talent? Here are some answers. Roxane Mbanga also takes a look at the place of black women in contemporary art. Finally, Alex Vizorek draws a portrait of the American painter John Singer Sargent.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: La Galerie Dior retraces the story of the famous French haute couture house, a tribute to the genius of Christian Dior and his successors. All about French lawyers' robes. L'Ingénieur Chevallier, the oldest French opticians, takes over Maison Bonnet, flagship of luxury eyewear. Wearing a bra as a top.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S09
programme.sub-title: Special programme: around and about in Lausanne
programme.desc: We explore the canton's fine arts museum and its collections. Michelin-starred chef Franck Giovannini unpacks his bags in Crissier, in the canton of Vaud. With Viktor & Rolf, dresses and acres of tulle are turning heads. We meet Alexandre and Martino, founders of Swiss Koo.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.desc: For autumn-winter 2023-2024, the Barbara Bui collection is presented in the form of small, slow motion clips. Tailoring, a pop-rock spirit and nonconformism await us.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: Chic en VF
programme.desc: The New National Museum of Monaco offers a showcase for contemporary art. Sommelier Patrice Frank recounts the story of a cellar unlike any other.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.desc: Lyn Abdel Rahman presents Le Fil Paris, the brand she founded with Filza Marri, featuring a responsible philosophy focused on human beings and zero waste and with an initial fashion show in tribute to Lebanon and Pakistan.

programme.title: HABITANTS DU NORD
programme.desc: Last adventures in Tombstone Territorial Park: the duo decides to do some canoeing and a guided mountain hike. Halfway through the hike, Nadia has to give up but Vincent makes it to the summit.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Between craftwork and tradition, we visit the Basque and History of Bayonne Museum. The mosaic artist Anne-Cécile Lopez reinterprets an age-old art, at the crossroads between archaeology, geology and anthropology. Marc Jacobs' anniversary show offers a contemporary view of the domestic world. Charlotte Franier restores old paintings.

programme.title: #VF
programme.sub-title: Ivana Barbarito and Benjamin Bancel, architects and designers
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: Legendary and highly recommended: L'Éclaireur, the concept store by Armand Hadida. All about the origins of the carat, the unit of measurement that governs the jewellery industry. Anicet: starting from what already exists and offering a new life to jewellery. Shorts and skirts: the elegant way to wear ultra-short hemlines.

programme.title: LA BELLE VIE S03
programme.desc: Julien meets Joanie and Hugues, two former members of the armed forces, just a few days be-fore they set sail for the southern seas. Aboard their catamaran, they plan to spend five years seeking out the finest kitesurfing spots around the globe.

programme.title: #VF
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S09
programme.desc: Hélène Morbu, Marie-Amélie and Marie-Caroline Guillot, Annelise Michelson share one thing in common: ceramics. When the hand knows nothing but music: being a creator of notes. Meeting the leatherworkers: Valentine Huyghues Despointes and the craftsmen and women of Atelier Tassin. Milliners, cabinetmakers, fan-makers: Anthony Peto, Alain Taral, the Duvelleroy company.

programme.title: Chic en VF
programme.desc: The Cherqui Foundation, a collection of optical and cinematic artworks. Encounter with Jean-Guillaume Mathiaut, an artist whose work never fails to enchant, and his passion for architecture and cabinet-making.

programme.title: LA BELLE VIE S03
programme.sub-title: A life of simplicity in the Acadian forest
programme.desc: Julien is welcomed by Anne Galant who hand-built her house on Prince Edward Island. She shares her story and explains how it led to her living a simple life in a haven of peace and tran-quillity.

programme.title: Démo de Mode
programme.sub-title: Demo de Mode - Julie de Libran
programme.desc: One of the most Parisian and unusual designers discusses her spring-summer 2023 haute couture collection. The focus is firmly on the versatility of the garments, the work on the bias and sequins...

programme.title: HABITANTS DU NORD
programme.desc: At kilometer 371 of Dempster Highway, Nadia and Vincent treat themselves to some creature comforts at the Eagle Plains hotel. They make the acquaintance of Steve, a truck driver and philosopher. Finally, they meet up with Jesse for a bike ride of 34 kilometers.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10
programme.desc: Avenue Marceau, Paris, the Yves Saint Laurent Museum is dedicated to the great French fashion designer. Chef Philip Chronopoulos officiates beneath the arcades of the Palais Royal.
